notes: Sepolia (11155111) test configuration. Deploy the three mocks before the two purchase contracts, resolving backward references to those deployments. $owner is the supplied test deployment wallet: initial MockOG holder, immutable payment vault, explicit owner of both applications and initial royalty receiver. The factory receives none of these roles. MockOG is notoken (nt), 18 decimals, with an initial supply of 1 whole token (1000000000000000000 units) to $owner; its public mint faucet can increase supply. MockSwarmPepe permits public minting, and MockDelegateRegistry lets each vault grant or revoke its own token-specific delegations. House and deed initial prices are respectively 100000 and 250000 whole tokens; both immutable price notices are 0 seconds. Buyers use a separate funded payer wallet because a positive purchase cannot credit the payment vault through a self-transfer. Mint test funds, approve the relevant application for its exact current price, then call buyHouse(maxPrice), buyHouseFor(account,maxPrice), or mint(pepeId,maxPrice). A deed payer must own the Pepe or hold its registry delegation; the deed goes to the Pepe owner. Payments go directly from the payer: floor(price/2) to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD and the remainder to the vault, with exact balance checks. Owners can set prices, pause purchases and transfer or renounce administration; the OGClubDeeds administrator can also set the metadata prefix until permanently frozen and adjust the royalty receiver and rate up to 10% (initially 5%). The initial metadata prefix is empty; no initialization call is included. This manifest uses the same supplied wallet for test deployer and owner. Mainnet requires a separate configuration with the existing OG token, Swarm Pepe 0x999ce0CE8C5f7661e0c74a568FfE27CEB9177bDB, delegate.xyz v2 0x00000000000000447e69651d841bD8D104Bed493, the real farming vault, a fresh deployer, a Safe owner and PRICE_NOTICE=604800. No deployment or broadcast is performed by this assignment.
